title: AXIOM: Benchmarking LLM-as-a-Judge for Code via Rule-Based Perturbation and Multisource Quality Calibration

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM-as-a-judge generated scores against human-verified ground-truth scores using statistical metrics (mean, standard deviation, and Krippendorff's alpha) to identify deviations such as overly pessimistic/harsh grading.

Evaluating LLM performance on fine-grained binary classification tasks (defective vs. non-defective code) using precision, recall, and Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC) to detect a disproportionate tendency to hallucinate defects and produce false positives.

Isolating correctly evaluated programs and comparing the LLM's classification of required refinement (minor tweak vs. major refactoring) against the ground truth to identify a pronounced tendency to overestimate the scope of localized corrections.
